journal.title: Live and Mediated User Engagements: A Comparative Dataset from Two Bengali Audio-Story-Based YouTube Channels
journal.description: Comparative Bengali YouTube audio-story dataset with 250K+ comments and 300K+ live chats for digital humanities and social media engagement research.

under_review.title: ICFNet: An Incongruence-Aware Cross-Modal Unified Framework for YouTube Clickbait Detection with Multimodal LLM Comparison
under_review.description: Multimodal clickbait detection via RoBERTa + ConvNeXtV2 cross-attention and incongruence-aware FiLM gating; 92.04% accuracy / 97.51% AUC on YTClickbait21K.

under_review.title: YTClickbait21K: Human-Annotated Multimodal Dataset for YouTube Clickbait Detection Across Diverse Channels and Content Categories
under_review.description: Human-annotated multimodal dataset of 21,238 YouTube videos from 40 channels across 29 countries.

under_review.title: Encoder–Encoder Cross Attention Based Contextual Sarcasm Detection
under_review.description: Contextual cross-attention sarcasm detection with sarcasm-adaptive ELECTRA pretraining; up to 83.72% accuracy.

under_review.title: Unified Privacy Score: A Multi-Dimensional Framework for Attack-Aware Privacy and Utility Evaluation
under_review.venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
under_review.description: Unified Privacy Score integrating syntactic, semantic, information-theoretic, and adversarial-resilience dimensions across 11 anonymization methods and 16 attacks.

conference.title: Multilingual Hate Speech and Slang Detection: Evaluating Hybrid Transformers Against Zero-Shot and Few-Shot LLMs Struggling with Short and Low-Context Texts
conference.description: Hybrid transformers vs. zero/few-shot LLMs for multilingual hate speech and slang in short, low-context texts.

conference.title: Explainable AI-Driven Improved Disease Prediction through Symptom Analysis with Custom BERT
conference.description: Custom BERT hybrid disease prediction with XAI; 99% accuracy on Symptom2Disease.

conference.title: Analyzing Audience Engagement in Esports: Sentiment and LLM-Based Topic Insights from Live Chats in South Asia
conference.description: Sentiment and topic analysis of ~15M PUBG Mobile live chats across South Asia.

conference.title: Detecting Discrepancy to Enhance the Accuracy of Sentiment and Emotion Analysis: A Study Based on Bangla E-commerce Dataset
conference.description: Discrepancy detection preprocessing improving Bangla e-commerce sentiment/emotion accuracy.

conference.title: Consistency of Contextual Embedding in Literary Texts
conference.description: BERT contextual embeddings for thematic consistency in literary texts.

conference.title: Navigating Bengali Linguistics: Insights from Machine and Deep Learning Perspectives for Categorization of Sentences
conference.description: Bengali sentence classification on BTSD; BERT vectorization reaches 98.07% accuracy.
